inputImages.role: Rejected wizard-costume draft; preserve facial identity/body/material while replacing clothing and scholar prop/gesture

ownerRequest: do it #, accepting the proposed shift away from wizard costume to layered dark membranes attached to grown obsidian, exposed astral anatomy and markings beneath skin
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / wardrobe and prop redesign.
Edit the supplied SHADE concept sheet. The current hood, tailored robe, belt and spellbook have been REJECTED as generic wizard costume. Replace that entire costume vocabulary with embodied dark astral regalia. This needs a visible, fundamental change, not a different dress.

PRESERVE her exact exposed facial identity, intelligent knowing expression, two eyes, alien cranial ridges, adult feminine body proportions and beautiful living indigo-pearl skin. Preserve the studio lighting, warm grey background, full-body-left / portrait-upper-right / hand-detail-lower-right sheet layout. She remains a transformed alien priest-shaman and scholar whose camp upgrades unlock orders. No new abilities or injuries.

REMOVE COMPLETELY: hood/cowl, shoulder capelet, stitched robe, sleeves, tailored bodice, belt and buckle, robe skirt, ornamental stitched gold diagrams, boots and the entire book. Reveal her existing head uncovered; continue its organic cranial structure naturally without inventing a crown or hairstyle. No third eye, transparent brain, dreads, halo, antlers or horns.

NEW REGALIA -- GROWN INTO HER, DARK AND CEREMONIAL:
Her skin and body augmentation carry three clear layers, organised in long asymmetric curves that follow her anatomy.
- First, grown polished OBSIDIAN structural ridges trace one collarbone, the outer ribs and the hip crests. They emerge seamlessly from the tissue with subtle biological transitions. Large smooth dark facets with restrained worn gold at the living joins. No medieval armour suit, shoulder pauldrons, metal breast cups, exoskeleton machinery or leather straps.
- Second, broad opaque BLACK BIOLOGICAL MEMBRANES attach directly into those ridges. These are substantial, supple, velvety living sheets, like dark nacre turned flexible. One broad asymmetric membrane passes from a shoulder ridge diagonally across the torso to the opposite hip, providing continuous solid chest coverage. A separate continuous opaque wrap grows around the pelvis and upper inner thighs. Attachment is embedded growth, not clasps/seams/stitches. Keep the chest and groin fully covered, with no cleavage or lingerie silhouette. Expose the head, shoulders, arms, parts of the flanks and the lower legs, roughly half the visible body surface.
- Third, exactly THREE broader layered membrane extensions emerge from the hip/back anchors and fall close alongside the legs, one ending near the knee and two near the calf. Their staggered edges suggest a changing silhouette without spreading sideways. They have thickness, weight, a quiet restrained curve and subtly semi-translucent edges; opaque centres. No repeated little strips, ruffles, fabric puddle or floor train. They must not resemble feathers, moth/bat wings, leaf armour, tentacles or shredded cloth. No wide wing-like cape, elevated sleeve or free-floating disconnected pieces.

Keep this coherent, austere and almost alienly ceremonial. It is not fashionwear, a witch outfit, a dark-elf leather costume, a fantasy bikini or a bodysuit. No manufactured belt, zip, corset, dress tailoring or decorative surface embroidery. A small broken cult sigil is embedded at the sternum anchor as an incomplete old-gold line, never a big jewellery pendant.

SCHOLAR IDENTITY WITHOUT THE SPELLBOOK:
Change ONLY the hands' action enough to remove the book convincingly. One forearm turns slightly toward the viewer at waist height, palm relaxed and open. Her other fingertip carefully follows a fine geometric pattern visible beneath the exposed forearm skin. Beneath skin on that forearm and one upper shoulder are quiet ancient-gold branching marks interrupted by dark organic seams, like complex knowledge incorporated into her body. These are subdermal structures, not bright tattoos, floating UI, readable text, glowing spells or a new declared game power. Her expression is the same knowing, observant slight amusement from the source. No weapon, staff, orb, floating relic or holographic projection. Lower-right detail now shows the fingertip and subdermal marked forearm instead of the removed book.

COLOUR AND PRESENCE:
Living indigo/pewter-violet nacre with soft pearlescent reflected highlights; black obsidian, void-dark membrane and very restrained ANCIENT GOLD. Keep substantial body anatomy and skin texture alive. No neon, rainbow glitter, luminous cyan, emissive runes or latex gloss. Black haze leaks in a few close controlled curls from the growth joins and ankles. It does not hide the silhouette or become robes itself.

Match the new regalia accurately across all three views. The upper-right portrait is hoodless and shows the uncovered same face, original head anatomy and grown collarbone/shoulder regalia. Entire figure and bare original biological feet with small grown obsidian ankle/instep reinforcement visible; no pointed fashion shoes. Keep her pose composed and grounded. Retain the exact headings "SHADE" and "ORDERS / PRIEST-SHAMAN". One premium original science-fantasy concept sheet with calm readable large shapes, not an action scene or magical-school illustration.
inspection: Visually inspected full sheet. Hood, book, belt, conventional robe and boots removed. Same recognisable face/expression/cranial ridges and nacre material retained. Regalia now uses diagonal body-following black layers anchored at shoulder/ribs/hips with exposed arms/flanks/legs, dark low haze, bare feet with grown ankle support, and finger tracing forearm markings. Main figure/portrait/detail agree. Limits: membrane extensions look petal-like and number more than the specified three; gold outlines can read as decorative trim; forearm marks are visibly surface-like rather than decisively subdermal. These are owner-review observations, not an appearance lock or reason for an unauthorised extra pass.
scope: One Shade concept edit. No specific injury, new game mechanics, additional Pals, PixelLab, sprite conversion, animations, production integration, code/build/Unity interaction, commits or pushes.
